policy.preferred_interface: Use `omarchy <group> <action>` when a documented route exists.
policy.inspect_first: Never guess window, monitor, workspace, audio node, Bluetooth address, or network connection identifiers.
policy.verify_after_write: After a state-changing operation, query the affected subsystem and compare with the requested state.
policy.config_write_boundary: Read /usr/share/omarchy freely; never edit it for user customization. Write user overrides under ~/.config.
policy.confirmation: Ask immediately before destructive, privilege-expanding, package/system update, reboot, shutdown, disk, or credential-affecting operations.
